CustomField.description: Used for List View to accurately show "My Account Plans" to anyone who is marked in one of the four account coverage fields (BDE, CDE, BDE-DB&R, or CDE-DB&R)
CustomField.formula: if ( OR($User.Id = Account__r.Primary_BDE__r.Id, $User.Id = Account__r.Primary_CDE__r.Id, $User.Id = Account__r.Primary_BDE_DB_R__r.Id, $User.Id = Account__r.Primary_CDE_DB_R__r.Id) , "My Account Plans", "Not")
CustomField.label: Running User Coverage
